AUTOANTHONYRELICS-ENABLED.title: Enable Anthony Algorithm - Relics
AUTOANTHONYRELICS-ENABLED.hover.desc: Master switch. When off: generated relics stop spawning, the reward pool returns to vanilla relics, and owned generated relics have no effect.
AUTOANTHONYRELICS-REPLACE_VANILLA_RELICS: When on: vanilla relics are stripped from the run grab bag, so every reward source (combat, chests, shops, events) offers generated relics only. Ancients, starters, Neow and event-fixed relics are always untouched.
AUTOANTHONYRELICS-KEEP_MODDED_RELICS.hov: When on: relics from other BaseLib mods (e.g. Qurious Crafting - Relics) stay in the pool alongside generated relics - install order does not matter. When off, only generated relics are kept.
